INSERT INTO sys_message_log (message_id,user_id,read_time,is_deleted) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},NULL,TRUE)
ON CONFLICT (message_id,user_id) DO UPDATE SET is_deleted = TRUE ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_deleted = TRUE

INSERT INTO sys_message_log (message_id,user_id,read_time,is_deleted) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{readTime},FALSE)
ON CONFLICT (message_id,user_id) DO UPDATE SET read_time = CASE WHEN sys_message_log.is_deleted = FALSE THEN COALESCE(sys_message_log.read_time,EXCLUDED.read_time) ELSE sys_message_log.read_time END
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE read_time = IF(is_deleted = FALSE,COALESCE(read_time,VALUES(read_time)),read_time)
